messages:
leo: FYI ran into a bad perf/regression with the latest async python SDK on staging. Quick burst test shows tons of short TCP connections instead of reusing keepalive. FD climbs until worker restarts.

leo: Minimal repro for our environment:
```py
import asyncio
from redwood import AsyncClient

async def once():
    async with AsyncClient(api_key=\"x\") as c:
        await c.generate(\"ping\")

async def main(n):
    await asyncio.gather(*[once() for _ in range(n)])

asyncio.run(main(2000))
```

leo: Using uvloop and high concurrency we see nearly 2k sockets in TIME_WAIT. No obvious connection reuse in ss output.

anya: do you see any warnings like \"Unclosed client session\"?

leo: yes intermittent \"Unclosed client session\" in the logs. Strange because we use async context manager.

phil: probably a connector lifecycle bug. If the typed wrapper creates a new aiohttp TCPConnector per client and we don't await .close() on it when the wrapper is GC'd, that can leak.

leo: i instrumented SDK: AsyncClient.__aexit__ calls await self._session.close(), but AutoClient wrapper only calls self._inner.__aexit__ without awaiting in some codepath. Also a few lines use asyncio.create_task(self._session.close()) instead of await, which could be cancelled.

anya: ugh. create_task without awaiting means shutdown racing with process exit. Also CancelledError during __aexit__ could skip close unless shielded.

phil: short-term mitigation: add parameter reuse_connector=True to AsyncClient which accepts an external TCPConnector. SDK can provide a ClientFactory that returns clients sharing one connector. People who accidentally create many clients will get keepalive.

leo: can you add a repro/test that spawns many short-lived clients against a local TLS echo and asserts connection_count stays stable?

phil: yes. i'll add an integration test using pytest-asyncio + a simple aiohttp testserver. The test will assert netstat shows <100 ephemeral sockets after 2k requests.

anya: also add an internal lint rule: avoid ContextManager within tight loops. Recommend reusing a single AsyncClient instance or use ClientFactory. Add a devex recipe in docs.

leo: found weird behavior when we cancel tasks mid-request. When CancelledError happens inside __aexit__, the awaited session.close() can be interrupted. Suggest wrapping __aexit__ cleanup in asyncio.shield.

phil: agree. Implementation plan: (1) ensure AsyncClient.__aexit__ uses shield around connector/session close, (2) remove any background create_task-based closes and always await aclose(), (3) add reuse_connector option and a weakref-backed factory, (4) expose pool_size and keepalive_timeout as public config, (5) add typed signatures so __aenter__ returns AsyncClient in stubs.

anya: please also add tests for CancelledError during exit and for use with uvloop specifically; uvloop changes GC timing.

leo: i'll run the staging burst after patch lands. If we still see fd growth, i can try the factory approach in prod.

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: feature/async-reuse-fixes -> staging, rollback window 30m. CI: unit + integration green.

phil: i'll own the SDK changes + tests. anya can own docs and lint recipe. leo pls ping when you rerun.

leo: thanks all, will report results here. :rocket:
